logic.entry: Buy the whole one-asset sleeve at the common first executable OOS minute open.
logic.exit: Hold through OOS and terminal-liquidate with the same costs.

sources.citation: Shi, Y., Li, X., & Zhang, J. (2021). Up or down? Short-term reversal, momentum, and liquidity effects in cryptocurrency markets. International Review of Financial Analysis, 78, 101908. DOI:10.1016/j.irfa.2021.101908.
sources.finding_summary: The authors study daily cross-sectional cryptocurrency returns and report that very liquid large-cap assets can show daily momentum even where the broad cross-section exhibits reversal. This motivates a low-turnover BTC/ETH relative-strength allocation screen; their broad-universe result does not validate a two-asset portfolio.
